questions.question: Which campaign was launched by the Women and Child Development Ministry to eliminate child marriages in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bal Vivah Mukt Bharat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Women and Child Development Ministry launched the "Bal Vivah Mukt Bharat" campaign to eliminate child marriages.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The campaign focuses on high-burden states where child marriage rates are significantly above the national average.
 
• Approximately 200,000 child marriages were prevented in the past year as part of this initiative.
 
• The goal is to reduce child marriage rates to below 5% by 2029.
 
• The campaign prioritizes seven states: West Bengal, Bihar, Jharkhand, Rajasthan, Tripura, Assam, and Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Nearly 300 districts across India report child marriage rates above the national average.
 
• Child marriage impacts one in five girls in India before they reach the legal age of 18.
 
• The initiative aims to engage all states and Union Territories to implement targeted action plans.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Child Marriage in India:**__

 __
 
• Approximately one in five girls in India is married before the age of 18.
 
• Child marriage limits educational, health, and economic opportunities for girls.
 
 
 
• **Legal Measures:**__
 
 
• The Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006, prohibits child marriages in India.
 
• Various government schemes such as Beti Bachao Beti Padhao and Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana aim to uplift and protect girl children.

questions.question: What is the name of the mission approved by the Union Cabinet to improve weather and climate forecasting in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mission Mausam**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mission Mausam was approved by the Union Cabinet with an outlay of Rs. 2,000 crore over two years.**
 
• **It aims to enhance India’s weather and climate-related science, research, and services.**
 
• The mission will include advanced observation systems, high-performance computing, AI, and machine learning for precise weather forecasting.
 
• It will directly benefit several sectors like agriculture, disaster management, defence, environment, aviation, and more by providing accurate and timely weather information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Next-Gen Technology:** The mission will deploy next-generation radars, satellite systems, and high-performance supercomputers with advanced sensors.
 
• **Key Institutions:** The mission will be implemented by the **India Meteorological Department, the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology, and the National Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasting.**
 
• **Global Collaboration:** The mission will also involve collaboration with national and international institutes, academia, and industries.
 
• **Areas of Impact:** It will improve predictions for monsoon forecasts, air quality alerts, extreme weather events, and more, benefiting sectors like agriculture, disaster management, and health.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Capacity Building:** The mission aims to enhance India's capacity in weather surveillance, modelling, and forecasting.
 
• **Earth System Models:** The mission will develop advanced Earth system models for improved decision-making.
 
• **Real-Time Data Dissemination:** The mission will deploy a GIS-based automated Decision Support System for real-time weather and climate data dissemination.
 
• **Climate Resilience:** It will help strengthen climate resilience across sectors and communities, addressing the impacts of climate change effectively.

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding the SUBHADRA scheme launched by Prime Minister Modi in Odisha is correct?

options.text: The scheme provides financial support to women aged 21-50 years.
Beneficiaries receive Rs 5,000 annually for 10 years.
The scheme provides Rs 50,000 over 5 years to women aged 21-60 years.
The funds are transferred quarterly to the beneficiaries' accounts.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The scheme provides Rs 50,000 over 5 years to women aged 21-60 years.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The SUBHADRA scheme, launched by Prime Minister Modi in Odisha, provides Rs 50,000 over 5 years to women aged 21-60 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The scheme aims to benefit over 1 crore women in Odisha.
 
• Funds are directly credited to Aadhaar-linked bank accounts via DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer).
 
• The scheme is linked to a pilot project with RBI's digital currency initiative.
 
• Under this, all eligible beneficiaries between the age of 21-60 years would receive Rs. 50,000/- over a period of 5 years between 2024-25 to 2028-29.
 
• An amount of Rs 10,000/- per annum in 2 equal installments will be credited directly to the beneficiary’s Aadhaar-enabled & DBT-enabled bank account.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **SUBHADRA Scheme**__: A women-centric financial support scheme launched in Odisha.
 
• __**Aadhaar-Linked Bank Accounts**__: A system where funds are transferred directly to verified bank accounts linked to Aadhaar.
 
• __**DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer)**__: A system ensuring that subsidies and benefits reach the eligible beneficiaries directly into their bank accounts.

Consider the following statements regarding the Eklavya Platform:

1.The Eklavya Platform was launched by the Ministry of Minority Affairs.

2.The theme for 2024 is the "Year of Technology Absorption."

3. The platform has been developed through Bhaskaracharya National Institute of Space Applications and Geoinformatics (BISAG-N).

How many of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Chief of the Army Staff (COAS) General Upendra Dwivedi launched the** Eklavya Platform.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• It is an **online learning platform **for the **Indian Army**, not by Minority Affairs***. Hence, statement 1 is incorrect. ***
 
• It aligns with the Indian Army propelling itself into the **“Decade of Transformation”** and with Indian **Army’s theme** for 2024 as the “**Year of Technology Absorption**.” ***Hence, statement 2 is correct. ***

questions.question: Under the One Nation One Subscription (ONOS) initiative, What is the primary goal of the initiative in terms of subscription management for government institutions and R&D labs?

options.text: To increase the number of journal subscriptions
To consolidate individual subscriptions for cost efficiency
To encourage private sector participation in journal subscriptions

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**To consolidate individual subscriptions for cost efficiency**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Union Cabinet approved the ‘One Nation One Subscription’ (ONOS) initiative** on November 25, 2024, for centralized access to research articles and journal publications for government institutions and R&D labs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **central government allocated ₹6,000 crore** for ONOS until 2027, aiming to cover **higher education institutions and R&D institutions** in both central and state governments.
 
• ONOS consolidates individual subscriptions to academic journals and publications into a **single, centrally negotiated payment** for all institutions.
 
• The initiative will replace the **existing costly individual subscriptions** to scientific journals, which in 2018 amounted to **₹1,500 crore** for India.
 
• Institutions have spent **₹30-50 crore** on access to popular databases like **SCOPUS** and **Web of Science**.
 
• In 2022, the government spent about **₹995 crore** on journal subscriptions, which was part of a larger expenditure of **₹2,985 crore** between 2019 and 2022.
 
• **ONOS aims to lower costs** for journal subscriptions and **provide concessions** on fees for authors publishing in open-access journals.
 
• The scheme was recommended under the **Science, Technology, and Innovation Policy 2020** to facilitate knowledge-sharing.
 
• **Stakeholder consultations for ONOS began in 2021**, with publishers such as **Elsevier, Springer Nature, Taylor and Francis, and Wiley** involved in negotiations.
 
• The implementation of ONOS is overseen by a **core committee** led by the **Principal Scientific Advisor of India**, with members from various ministries, including Education and Science & Technology.

questions.question: Which ministry launched the Namo Drone Didi Scheme aimed at empowering Women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) in agriculture?

options.text: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Indian government has introduced the Namo Drone Didi Scheme, aimed at providing drones to Women Self Help Groups (SHGs).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **The scheme, approved by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, has an outlay of ₹1,261 crore and will benefit 14,500 selected Women SHGs from 2024-25 to 2025-26.**
 
• Under the scheme, 80% of the cost of drones and accessories** (up to a maximum of ₹8 lakhs) will be funded for the SHGs**. The remaining amount will be raised as a loan through the National Agriculture Infra Financing Facility.
 
• Members of the** SHGs will undergo 15 days of training,** which includes mandatory drone pilot training and additional training focused on agricultural applications like nutrient and pesticide spraying.
 
• Lead Fertilizer Companies will facilitate the program, coordinating with state departments, drone manufacturers, and farmers to ensure effective implementation.
 
• **Objective**: The initiative aims to enhance agricultural productivity and empower women in rural areas by providing them with modern agricultural tools and training.

questions.question: What is the name of the scheme launched by MeitY to support the growth of software startups in India, providing funding and mentorship through accelerators?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Samridh Scheme.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **MeitY has launched the Samridh Scheme to foster the growth of software startups in India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Samridh stands for Startup Accelerators of MeitY for Product Innovation, Development, and Growth.
 
• The scheme was launched under the National Policy on Software Products 2019.
 
• It aims to support 300 startups with funding of Rs 99 crore over four years.
 
• Startups receive up to Rs 40 lakh in funding and mentorship for business growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Samridh Scheme**__: Flagship initiative by MeitY to boost software product startups in India.
 
• __**Accelerators**__: Partners of the scheme that offer business development and investor connections to startups.

questions.question: Which portal was launched by Shri Piyush Goyal to improve the business environment and track suggestions for improvement?

options.text: Ease of Doing Business & Regulatory Affairs portal

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ease of Doing Business (EoDB) and Regulatory Affairs portal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Shri Piyush Goyal launched the CII Ease of Doing Business (EoDB) and Regulatory Affairs portal to enhance transparency and accountability in India's business environment.**
 
• The portal aims to track progress, submissions, and updates on Ease of Doing Business initiatives by the government and CII.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The portal includes a member dashboard for real-time tracking and ensuring meaningful resolution of concerns.
 
• Shri Goyal emphasized the importance of technological upgrades to improve the efficiency of State and Central government portals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• CII Ease of Doing Business (EoDB) and Regulatory Affairs Portal__

 __
 
• The portal is designed to offer insights into India’s business environment and help receive and track suggestions for improving the Ease of Doing Business.
 
• The portal also facilitates the National Single Window System (NSWS) to guide investors in applying for business-related approvals.
 
 
 
• Shri Piyush Goyal’s Vision__
 
 
• The Minister emphasized the need for a cooperative federalism approach and the importance of feedback from industry stakeholders to improve business processes.
 
• He urged stakeholders to work faster and harder to make India the third-largest economy in the next three years.
